name: Darrel Menthe
office: Culver City Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Darrel Menthe is the executive director of the Culver City Downtown Business Association and serves as chair of the Culver City Planning Commission. He previously served on the city's Finance Advisory Committee.

sentences.text: Darrel Menthe is the executive director of the Culver City Downtown Business Association and serves as chair of the Culver City Planning Commission.
He previously served on the city's Finance Advisory Committee.

items.text: His campaign priorities include fixing the district's finances, supporting honors classes, covering AP class costs, and reducing class sizes. He supports implementing term limits and campaign contribution limits for school board members. Menthe helped organize the petition drive for Measure AA, a parcel tax to fund local schools. He described it as a progressive tax that ensures commercial properties pay a proportionate share based on building size.
